name: args-are-appended-to-the-neurons-command
description: SPEC 8.4's worked fixture with both programs named by a file of their own, each entry adding `args` to the file's command (2.10, decision 0022): a level 0 neuron and a level 1 neuron. `args` changes the command started and no rule: the events are those of the same network with each neuron written inline with the longer command, which are those of routing/chain-forward-with-cause. The scripted programs stand in for the processes, so a fixture cannot see the arguments themselves.
